data.name: PdfNotReadable
data.value: The document could not be read as a PDF (PDFium error {0}).

data.name: PdfTooLarge
data.value: The PDF is larger than {0} bytes, the most Latiprimere can render.
data.comment: {0} is the limit in bytes, about 2 GB, formatted with digit grouping.

data.name: PdfPasswordProtected
data.value: The PDF is password-protected. Print it with PrintContent.FromPdf(stream, password).
data.comment: Thrown when a PDF needs a password and none was given.

data.name: PageLoadFailed
data.value: Page {0} of the PDF could not be loaded.

data.name: BitmapCreateFailed
data.value: PDFium could not create a bitmap for rendering.

data.name: PixelBufferTooSmall
data.value: The pixel buffer holds {0} bytes, but the band needs {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the buffer length, {1} the bytes needed.

data.name: StrideTooSmall
data.value: The stride must be at least the page width times 4 bytes.

data.name: BandOutsidePage
data.value: The band must lie within the page.

data.name: PdfPasswordWrong
data.value: The password given for the PDF doesn't open it.
data.comment: Thrown when a PDF's password was given but is wrong. Never include the password.
